say:0:1013613001:0.text: ...Seems like this gang of treasure thieves doesn't know that much.
say:0:1013613001:0.source_cn: ……看来，这群盗宝贼只知道这么多了。

say:1:1013613002:0.female: The Syndicate has its sights set on the Sun Temple, that much is clear.

say:2:1013613003:0.text: Then we better hurry to the Sun Temple!
